plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow BuildTrack to access your Face ID for secure sign-in.

plugins.photosPermission: BuildTrack needs photo access so you can attach site photos and receipts.
plugins.cameraPermission: BuildTrack needs camera access so you can capture site photos, videos and receipt scans.
BuildTrack uses the camera for site photos, progress videos and document scans.
plugins.microphonePermission: BuildTrack records audio with site progress videos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: BuildTrack verifies worker attendance against the pinned site location. Location data stays on your device unless you mark attendance.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: BuildTrack verifies worker attendance against the pinned site location. Location data stays on your device unless you mark attendance.

plugins.contactsPermission: BuildTrack imports worker names and numbers from your phone book when you choose to add them.
